Activist challenges Rs 10,000 peace bond order in Delhi High Court

Neha Bora, identified as the president of AISA, has challenged a Delhi Police notice ordering her to furnish a Rs 10,000 peace bond. Bora stated that the peace bond is incorrect and has filed a petition in the Delhi High Court against the notice. The order for the bond reportedly followed a protest in Delhi.
